keyEvents.text: Goal! Puebla 1, Atlético San Luis 0. Mathías Tomás (Puebla) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kevin Velasco following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury José Pachuca (Puebla).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Puebla. Fernando Monárrez replaces José Pachuca because of an injury.
Kevin Velasco (Puebla) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Eduardo Águila (Atlético San Luis) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
